LESSON: HEALING BY THE END OF THE SUB

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 3.4: Healing By the end of the sub

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healing By the end of the sub. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya
3. practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps
4. apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HEALING BY THE END OF THE SUB
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Healing By the end of the sub helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HEALING BY THE END OF THE SUB
Study Healing By the end of the sub like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Healing By the end of the sub” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Healing By the end of the sub in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Healing By the end of the sub” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Healing By the end of the sub is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Healing By the end of the sub” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Healing By the end of the sub in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Healing By the end of the sub” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Healing By the end of the sub in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Healing By the end of the sub to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Healing By the end of the sub in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Healing By the end of the sub from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Healing By the end of the sub: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Healing By the end of the sub?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Healing By the end of the sub means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Healing By the end of the sub means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Healing By the end of the sub from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
